findings.text: Early boot entries establish memory and paging defaults: one initializes NUMA state while another clears default node memory states for the boot node.
Initial NUMA configuration treats the entire physical span as belonging to node zero, providing a single node baseline before later topology handling.
Fill marker for unused vmemmap storage equals decimal 253.
Unused subrange tracking uses a cached start marker with zero meaning empty; flushing fills from the marker up to alignment and then resets the marker.
Whole PMD emptiness is decided by flushing cached state, marking the target subrange unused, then scanning the full PMD span for any different content.

Marking subranges used favors contiguity: a directly following span advances or clears the cached marker, while a disjoint span flushes old state and pins a small header portion as used; new spans also premark leading holes unused and remember trailing holes.
End of memory bookkeeping only grows global limits: when the computed end frame exceeds the current maximum, it raises related limits and recomputes the high memory boundary.
Page addition validates the direct map bound, delegates to a core adder with warning on failure, and updates global end variables except for device private mappings.
Architecture memory addition converts byte range to frames, establishes the address mapping with caller protection, then adds the page range for the given node.

Backing release distinguishes cases: reserved table pages use a reserved free path while others use a table free path; vmemmap backing prefers altmap release when present, else reserved or buddy release by reservation state.
Empty table reclamation scans all child slots and returns early if any slot remains populated; otherwise it frees the child table and clears the parent entry under lock.

Teardown walks the hierarchy from top to leaves, skipping absent parents, handling leaf mappings with alignment checks, recursing into tables for mixed spans, freeing emptied children, and flushing translation caches at key levels.
Low identity mapped region below one gigabyte cannot be torn down; encountering it aborts the current PTE sweep without further clearing.
All entry clearing during teardown and empty table freeing holds the initial address space page table lock around the clear operation.

Direct and vmemmap teardown differ: direct mode adjusts per level page counts while vmemmap mode releases backing pages and uses altmap where applicable, with leaf PUD removal requiring full alignment.

Late boot memory entry marks boot allocation finished, runs hypervisor post bootmem handling, optionally registers the vsyscall area for core dumps, and preallocates vmalloc tables; a companion preinit entry allocates IOMMU state.
Vmalloc table preallocation iterates the vmalloc span by top level steps, allocating intermediate tables for five level and four level shapes, and halts the boot if any allocation fails.

Read only finalization write protects the kernel text to rodata span, records completion in a global flag, makes post text mappings non executable up to aligned break, secures tracing operations, and releases image gaps between text and data.
Maximum hotplug block size equals two gigabytes.
Threshold for considering large hotplug blocks equals sixty four gigabytes.

Memory block size query caches its result: explicit administrator setting wins, small systems use a minimum, otherwise advised or default sizing is clamped and then reduced by halving until memory end alignment holds.
Large vmemmap installation records contiguity across calls for debug logging by comparing current backing and node against cached range state, and routes misaligned edges through subrange handling.

Vmemmap population validates page alignment, chooses base pages for small spans, huge pages when processor support exists, reports an error when altmap lacks processor support, and synchronizes global tables on success; a helper emits any pending contiguity log.
PMD reuse check treats leaf entries as large, verifies expected ownership for the span, marks the subrange used, and reports largeness to the caller.
Write combining IO mapping creation first checks addressability limits, reserves an IO memtype with negotiation, then derives kernel protection from the negotiated mode and masks unsupported bits.
IO memtype reservation sanity checks the range, reserves with type negotiation, validates the new type against policy, synchronizes kernel mappings, and frees back to busy on policy or sync failure.
IO mapping release frees the reserved memtype span covering base through base plus size.
Local IO mapping of a frame number downgrades non writeback requests to a compatible uncached mode when PAT is unavailable, masks unsupported protection bits, then creates a local mapping.
Descriptor carries a single unsigned flags field used to accumulate mapping attributes across resource walks.
RAM detection only considers system RAM resources, converts the resource span to frames with rounding, and reports system RAM mapping if any valid frame in the span is not reserved.
Encrypted mapping detection is inactive without guest memory encryption support; otherwise reserved and empty descriptors stay clear while other descriptors request encrypted mapping.
Collection accumulates RAM and encrypted indications once each and signals completion only when both indications are present.

General IO remap defaults to a conservative uncached compatible mode for driver compatibility while the strong uncached variant requests strict uncached mode; both delegate to a common caller aware helper.

Vmemmap free validates alignment then removes non direct mappings with altmap support; physical mapping removal translates to kernel addresses and removes direct mappings; architecture removal drops pages then tears down the direct mapping.
